about.description: QCOM on Crypto.com is a tokenized stock issued on the Cronos chain that tracks the price of QUALCOMM Incorporated. The token is a ledger based derivative issued by Foris Capital, so a holder takes price exposure without owning the underlying security and without voting or dividend rights. Dividends and corporate actions are applied by the issuer as adjustments to the token balance rather than paid out in cash. Trading runs around the clock inside the Crypto.com app with a minimum order size of one dollar and no commission. Redemption is settled for economic value rather than in shares, and tokens can be withdrawn to the Cronos chain for onchain use.
about.registryInfo: Foris Capital CY Limited is registered in the Republic of Cyprus with registration number HE 348194 and has its registered office at 47 Ioanni Kondylaki Street, Q Tower, Floor 5, CY 6042, Larnaca, Cyprus. It holds Cypriot Investment Firm licence 344/17 issued by the Cyprus Securities and Exchange Commission and issues the tokenized stocks offered in the European Economic Area. Foris Capital MU Ltd issues the tokenized stocks offered outside the European Economic Area under a separate set of terms. Both entities publish their terms under the Crypto.com brand.
